sections.title: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
paragraphs: This dossier compiles comparative projections for your upcoming career alternatives: Accelerated Growth (Lead Startup Engineer), Balanced Path (Senior Corporate Dev), and Defensive Hedge (Remote Freelancer).

Using your calibrated 'Builder' prior, the model weights equity acquisition and technical autonomy over administrative corporate scaling. Recommended focus is Scenario A, with Scenario C acting as a near-term capital buffer.

sections.title: TRADE-OFF MATRIX
paragraphs: Each option enforces specific constraints: Scenario A maximizes salary escalation rate and leadership potential, but incurs high volatility. Scenario B stabilizes base resources but delays entrepreneurship moves. Scenario C maximizes cash flexibility at the expense of equity assets.
